patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
Many reviews highlight negative interactions with staff, citing poor attitude or unhelpfulness.
Customers consistently experience long wait times for service or food.
A significant number of customers feel the prices are too high for the value received.
Several reviews mention unspecified negative experiences or issues not fitting other categories.
Some customers have noted issues with the restaurant's cleanliness.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of low-quality ingredients, or issues with recipe execution.

root_causes.pattern: Many reviews highlight negative interactions with staff, citing poor attitude or unhelpfulness.
root_causes.cause: Lack of proper staff training, insufficient staffing leading to burnout, or poor management oversight.

root_causes.pattern: Customers consistently experience long wait times for service or food.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing, inefficient kitchen operations, poor table management, or inadequate capacity during peak hours.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of customers feel the prices are too high for the value received.
root_causes.cause: Perceived low value for money, pricing not competitive with similar establishments, or portion sizes not justifying the cost.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews mention unspecified negative experiences or issues not fitting other categories.
root_causes.cause: Vague or miscellaneous issues that cannot be categorized further without more detailed review text.

root_causes.pattern: Some customers have noted issues with the restaurant's cleanliness.
root_causes.cause: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient staff for cleaning, or lack of regular maintenance.
